newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia to go ahead with DM bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Colombia to go ahead with DM bond issue.

text.p: Colombia will issue a floating rate Deutschmark bond issue, originally planned for late September, sometime next week, said Clemente del Valle, the finance ministry's chief of Public Credit.

Del Valle said the bond issue was being co-lead managed by Merrill Lynch and Deutsche Bank. He did not specify the exact amount of the issue, which he said would be placed through the Luxembourg stock exchange, but said it would probably total about 275 million marks.
Del Valle spoke in a brief telephone interview with Reuters before departing on a European road show to promote the sovereign debt issue. -- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
